findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_quote" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, search_site, list_manufacturing_tools, create_rfq, get_rfq_thread · Private data: fetch, get_design_rules, find_registered_businesses, create_rfq, get_rfq, upload_rfq_file, send_rfq_message, get_rfq_thread, submit_quote · Public sink: find_registered_businesses, submit_quote_request, create_rfq, upload_rfq_file, send_rfq_message, submit_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, search_site, list_manufacturing_tools, create_rfq, get_rfq_thread · Private data: fetch, get_design_rules, find_registered_businesses, create_rfq, get_rfq, upload_rfq_file, send_rfq_message, get_rfq_thread, submit_quote · Public sink: find_registered_businesses, submit_quote_request, create_rfq, upload_rfq_file, send_rfq_message, submit_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
